scientific_question: Can a reference-blind observable-state controller convert the large unused physical deadline into scan exposure and useful VERIFY allocation across both videos?

competing_hypotheses.H1: The fixed planned action ceiling is the dominant residual bottleneck; observable stage switching increases positive exposure and cross-video quality.
competing_hypotheses.H0: The recoverability ceiling is not realizable under the frozen frontier, oracle latency, and deadline guard; extra scans do not produce timely unique-event gains.

F0.role: best fixed policy control selected before this cycle by H-BOTTLE2 macro AnytimeAUC_F1

ST1.persistent_candidate: retained candidate created before the current completed scan
rules_in_order: SCAN while below coarse coverage and persistent candidate count is below capacity
SCAN a max-gap cell when eligible retained candidates occupy at most one temporal unit-cell
VERIFY a persistent candidate when the unchanged guard admits VERIFY plus durable commit
otherwise SCAN a max-gap cell when the unchanged scan-plus-commit reservation admits it
after a confirmed event, suppress its unit/K3-derived neighboring cell through the frozen cell-diverse rule
when VERIFY is not admitted, continue safe SCAN rather than terminating if scan-plus-commit remains admissible

frozen_variables: two videos, two queries, and four task identities
YOLOV8/Y8 weights, feature schema, sampling FPS, candidate threshold, and capacity
physical Qwen3-VL-32B oracle, prompt, parser, frame sampling, clips, and normalization
unitization, K3 materializer, ontology, snapshot semantics, and deadline guard
T_transition and T_high deadlines, hardware, and complete physical accounting
changed_variables: continuation with safe SCAN after VERIFY becomes inadmissible
VERIFY frontier rule from FIFO to frozen cell-diverse conservative only in ST1
correctness_gate: F0 exactly reproduces C10 scan/query/label/proxy/snapshot signatures
ST1 consumes only public units, observed candidates, returned oracle rows, remaining deadline, and frozen latency bounds
deterministic action and query signatures across repeats
zero replay, future-proxy access, reference visibility violation, deadline miss, missing snapshot, or invalid action ledger
candidate capacity, guard, oracle, proxy, K3, and commit path are identical

physical_matrix.smoke: 2 methods x 4 tasks x T_transition x replicate 0 = 8; valid smoke counts as formal repeat 0
physical_matrix.formal: 2 methods x 4 tasks x 2 deadlines x 3 repeats = 48

quality_acceptance.cross_video: at least one improving task in each video
quality_acceptance.noninferiority: at least 3/4 tasks not worse in primary direction
quality_acceptance.mechanism_alignment: increased positive/event exposure and candidate-to-VERIFY conversion must align with quality

branch_after_cycle.accept: run one critical mechanism ablation and freeze only if the core candidate criteria survive
branch_after_cycle.near_miss: permit one single-component causal revision only when mechanism and quality improve but narrowly miss the threshold
branch_after_cycle.reject: kill the sole branch-specific rule route and set PSVR_TWO_VIDEO_SEARCH=NO_GO
